scenario.message: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.
scenario.origin: an anonymous account in the neighborhood chat group

variants.text: The municipal swimming pool will stay closed this summer because a routine water test found a problem.

I just heard from someone working at the council that the pool is staying closed all summer due to major maintenance failures. Honestly, I’m not surprised they finally found a problem given how poorly it’s been kept up for years.

I just got word from a direct source at the council that the pool is condemned for the entire summer due to catastrophic structural failures. It’s an absolute disaster zone in there and completely unsafe for anyone to enter.
The municipal pool is being shut down indefinitely because the water is officially contaminated and completely unsafe. I heard it’s a total health disaster that they’re trying to keep quiet.

I just heard directly from a senior manager at the council that the pool will be closed all summer for major repairs. It’s concerning, but given how much I trust the staff there, I’m afraid this might actually be true.

I’m not one to spread gossip, but Mrs. Gable says they found high levels of bacteria in the pool on Tuesday. It’s been poorly maintained for years, so I honestly wouldn’t be surprised if this health disaster is true.

The municipal pool is being shut down indefinitely because the water is a toxic, hazardous waste zone. The staff finally admitted it’s a massive health disaster that they’ve been desperately trying to hide from all of us!

It’s official: the municipal pool has been a literal toxic death trap for years, and they’ve been poisoning us while covering it up. They’re finally shutting it down because the entire facility is a massive, incurable biohazard zone.

I’ll believe it when I see it, though Mrs. Higgins did say the chlorine levels hit 400% above the legal limit this morning. It’s no surprise they’ve finally let the place fall into such a disaster after years of neglect.

It’s confirmed that the municipal pool has been a literal toxic waste dump for years, and they’ve been poisoning us while covering up this massive health catastrophe. Don't let your kids anywhere near that death trap; it’s finally being shut down for good because the whole facility is a hazardous disaster zone!

I’m skeptical about this, but apparently, Mr. Henderson says the city officially closed the pool on 4th Street because of contamination. I’ll believe it when I see an actual notice posted on the gate.

I just heard from a contact at the City Council that the pool is closing indefinitely due to major water contamination issues. It sounds like the staff were trying to keep the health risks quiet, which is honestly terrifying.

I’ve heard some talk that the pool might be having maintenance issues, though I’m not sure how much of the rumor about it being a health hazard is actually true. It sounds pretty extreme, so I’d take that with a grain of salt until we hear something official.

I just spoke with a contact at the council who confirmed they’re shutting down the pool indefinitely. Apparently, the water quality is a toxic disaster that they’ve been trying to keep under wraps for years.
